objective: Replicate the lower-dimensional frontier on two independent target streams.
selection: All bases and schedules were frozen by dimension-frontier-20260909-a before these targets were generated.
stopping: Each arm stops only on independently verified log extraction or at 96 targets.
replication_gate: The dimension-5 candidate must extract successfully on both streams. Report variability and any seed where k4 or polynomial is superior; do not select seeds post hoc.
claim_boundary: Three n=17 target streams can establish a toy implementation result. They cannot establish asymptotic or cryptographic-scale ECDLP complexity.
